correctness.rationale: Rebuilt all 28 chords and 322 nonempty matching faces; enumerated all barycentric strict chains and their exact rotation/dihedral orbits. Verified 139 genuine elementary free-face collapses reduce the dihedral quotient to a point. For rotations, 149 verified collapses produce a 20-vertex, 62-edge, 44-triangle CW complex; a 19-edge spanning tree contracts, followed by 42 geometric generator–relator eliminations, leaving one loop and attaching words a^{-2} and empty. The code reconstructs incidence and actual attaching words, not solely chain ranks or finite samples.

value.rationale: The octagon is the first polygon size in this family at which a cyclic symmetry quotient produces integral first-homology torsion: sizes at most four give graph quotients and explicit collapses show sizes five through seven remain graph-like. The simultaneous Moore-space torsion and contractible full dihedral quotient identify a natural stabilizer-sensitive topological transition not determined by Jonsson’s ordinary NXM homology.
